summary: Iteration 52 — Sections 49 (AI Banner), 50 (Verified Reviews + multi-channel share), 51 (ChipInput), 52 (Gallery +tile), 53 (ServiceAreasInput). Full E2E pass on backend (7/7 pytest) and frontend (chip add/remove, gallery tile, banner gen 1.2MB data-URL, verified badges, 8/8 share channels, QR modal).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 9188 lines — well over the 700-line recommended threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into modules (auth, providers, reviews, banners, service-requests, etc.). Will become unmaintainable as more sections land.

Two coexisting share UIs may confuse users: ShareLinkCard (8 channels, used in ProviderDashboard) vs ShareECard modal + ShareECardBlock (used on public /p/:slug eCard). Consider unifying on ShareLinkCard everywhere — the public eCard currently shows only a 3-button block (Share/QR/NFC) and hides the 8-channel options behind an extra modal click.
Banner endpoint has a hard 60s upstream timeout for gpt-image-1; if OpenAI is slow, users see a generic error. Consider returning queued job id + polling pattern for resilience.
Review delete endpoint behavior was not explicitly tested (cleanup is best-effort via DELETE /api/reviews/{id}). Verify owner-only authorization on that path.

Onboarding service-areas / services testids exist in code (ProviderOnboarding.jsx:266, :281) but could not be exercised live for demo.provider (already onboarded — page renders empty). Add a way to reset onboarding for QA, or render the inputs read-only when already completed instead of blank page.
seed_data_creation: Each test_iter52 review test signs up a unique TEST_iter52_<ts>@getamano.com client and cleans the review via DELETE /api/reviews/{id} in teardown. The test_review_verified_via_service_request creates one /api/service-requests row that is NOT cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint identified for service-requests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter52_sections_49_53.py is the authoritative regression for Sections 49-53. Banner test consumes 1 of 10 daily AI banners per run on demo.provider. Public provider eCard route is /p/:slug (NOT /services/:slug which is the category route). ShareLinkCard with 8 channels is on the ProviderDashboard resumen tab; public eCard uses a different (3-button) ShareECardBlock + a modal-triggered ShareECard with share-option-* testids.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — all 5 sections work as designed in code and in live preview environment.
